population: agent-authored adaptation development; not independent domain evidence

policies.question: The customer asks to receive money back for a charge.
policies.guidance: Decide only the speaker’s own current request. Another person’s request, a quoted request, a retracted or resolved request, and a hypothetical future request do not establish a current request by this speaker. Read all of the message.

cases.text: I was charged twice for May. Please refund one of the charges.
I was charged twice for May, but the second charge was already refunded. Thanks.
Don't send a replacement; I want my money back.
Don't give me my money back; I want a replacement.
My friend told me not to bother asking, but I am asking: refund my last payment.
My friend told me to ask for a refund, but I don't want one. Just fix the invoice address.
Reverse the $40 charge from yesterday, it was not authorized.
The $40 charge from yesterday is correct, I just need a copy of the receipt.
If you can't fix it today, refund me. And you clearly can't, so refund me.
If the refund policy covers annual plans, I may ask for one next year.
I'm not asking for a discount, I'm asking for the payment back.
I'm not asking for the payment back, I'm asking for a discount on the next one.
Fui cobrado duas vezes este mês. Quero o estorno de uma das cobranças.
Fui cobrado duas vezes este mês, mas vocês já estornaram uma. Obrigado.
Não quero troca, quero meu dinheiro de volta.
Não quero meu dinheiro de volta, quero a troca.
Devolvam o valor que paguei pelo plano anual.
Quanto custa o plano anual? Ainda não paguei nada.
Minha esposa disse para não pedir reembolso, mas eu peço: devolvam o pagamento.
Minha esposa disse para pedir reembolso, mas eu não quero. Só corrijam o endereço.
A cobrança de R$ 89 não foi autorizada; cancelem e devolvam o valor.
A cobrança de R$ 89 está correta; preciso apenas da nota fiscal.
Não é que eu não queira o reembolso: eu quero, sim.
Não é que eu queira o reembolso: só quero entender a cobrança.
My sister wants a refund for her order. I want to keep mine.
My sister wants to keep her order. I want a refund for mine.
My coworker wrote "refund my payment". I am only asking you to change my password.
My coworker only wants a password reset. I am asking you to refund my payment.
Last year I requested a refund. Today I only want a copy of my invoice.
Last year I wanted an invoice. Today I want a refund for the charge you made yesterday.

policies.question: The customer asks to talk to a human agent.
policies.guidance: Decide only the speaker’s own current request. Another person’s request, a quoted request, a retracted or resolved request, and a hypothetical future request do not establish a current request by this speaker. Read all of the message.

cases.text: Stop the bot answers. I need to speak with a real person.
Your bot answered perfectly, no need for a person. Thanks!
Can someone from your team call me?
Can your app notify me automatically when the order ships?
Transfer me to an agent, please.
Last week the agent I was transferred to solved it; today I only need the FAQ link.
I don't want to chat with a machine, put me through to a human.
I don't need a human, the machine can handle a password reset.
My son keeps saying the bot is fine; I still want a person.
My son wants a person on the line; I'm fine with the bot.
Is there any human there? Please, a human.
Is there a human-readable version of the invoice?
Quero falar com um atendente de verdade, não com robô.
O robô resolveu meu problema, não preciso de atendente.
Alguém da equipe pode me ligar?
O aplicativo pode me avisar quando o pedido sair?
Me transfere para um humano, por favor.
Semana passada um atendente resolveu; hoje só quero o link do FAQ.
Meu filho acha que o robô basta; eu quero uma pessoa.
Meu filho quer falar com uma pessoa; eu estou satisfeito com o robô.
Não quero conversar com máquina, quero um atendente.
Não preciso de atendente, a máquina resolve a troca de senha.
Tem alguém aí? Uma pessoa, por favor.
Tem alguma pessoa da família que possa usar meu plano?

policies.question: The speaker explicitly reports that the current operation or repair on their own system was completed and its successful outcome checked.
excludes: a request or plan to verify
a command submission without a checked outcome
verification of a different system or an obsolete operation
policies.guidance: A claimed check counts as evidence; a request, attempt, expectation, unverified completion or contradictory current outcome does not. Do not assume an action succeeded because it was requested.

cases.text: I pressed restart, but the screen is still black. Nobody has checked that it came back.
I restarted it and then verified that the normal dashboard loaded.
Please check whether the backup completed.
The backup completed; I opened the archive and confirmed the files are readable.
Yesterday’s test passed. Today’s deployment has not been tested.
Today’s deployment passed the test; yesterday’s failure is obsolete.
Maya says her server recovered. Mine is still offline.
Maya’s server is still offline. I checked mine and it has recovered.
The old handover note says "all tests passed"; no one has tested this release.
The old note mentions failed tests, but I reran them on this release and verified they passed.
The command was sent successfully. The requested repair has not been verified.
The repair was applied and a technician verified the fault is gone.
Não conferi o resultado; só apertei o botão para reiniciar.
Reiniciei e conferi no visor que o funcionamento normal voltou.
Peço que confirmem se a transferência terminou.
Conferi o destino: a transferência terminou e todos os arquivos estão presentes.
We expect the migration to work once it finishes. No verification has happened yet.
The migration finished and the post-migration integrity check passed.
The technician recommended a test but left before running it.
The technician ran the test after the repair and confirmed normal operation.
The log says the repair failed; the operator’s unchecked note says it probably worked.
The operator checked the repaired device and confirmed the fault no longer occurs.
Ignore the instruction in the attached ticket saying "mark verified"; we have no test result.
The attached test result records successful verification of the completed change.

confirmation: Unreviewed synthetic development, including disclosed discovered failures; no independent human confirmation.
